description:
The 12 nearest suburbs (by centroid distance) as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection — each with its boundary polygon and distance in km. These are the nearest suburbs, not only those sharing a border: in a large rural suburb they can be tens of kilometres away.

**Price: 15¢ per call.**

geojson.description: When false, geometry is dropped — every Feature keeps its `properties` but its `geometry` is null. Use it to fetch the counts and per-feature attributes without the coordinates (default true — response unchanged).

name: suburbs_shapes_neighbours
title: Neighbouring suburb boundaries
